title: Contacts
intro: The head archive and its branches. Phone numbers and e-mail addresses are given as published by the archive.
unavailable: Contact details are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

data.title: What data is processed
data.text: Browsing the catalogue, news and reference sections does not require registration. The site does not ask visitors for personal data in these sections.

search.title: Search queries
search.text: Search queries may be stored in anonymised form for statistics: without IP addresses and without visitor identifiers.

cookies.title: Cookies and settings
cookies.text: The site remembers the selected language and colour theme. Session cookies are used only by staff who sign in to the site management system.

external.title: External links
external.text: Visits to eGov.kz, e-Otinish, social networks and map services are governed by the policies of those resources.

contact.title: Questions about data
contact.text: For questions about the processing of personal data, contact the archive using the details in the Contacts section.
